attr.title: Postal 2
attr.desc: POSTAL 2 through Box86, gl4es and a TSPS 32-bit to 64-bit GLES bridge.
attr.inst: Copy a legally owned Linux Postal 2 1409 archive named Postal 2.zip into the postal2 folder before first launch.
attr.desc_md: POSTAL 2 is a first-person action game from Running With Scissors. This port targets TSPS through the Linux x86 build, Box86, gl4es and a native 32-bit to 64-bit GLES presenter.
